tasks.title: Armour-piercing fire skips the vehicle exemption and the roll clamp
tasks.why: DirectFire.cs:365 halves the chance of any shooter moving faster than CombatTables.MovingSpeed (0.5 m/s): `if (SimMath.Length(Velocity[i]) > MovingSpeed) odds *= MovingAccuracy;`. Every other fire path in the same file exempts a machine, because a hull is a stable platform -- DirectFire.cs:393 and DirectFire.Wrecks.cs:168 both add `&& (Flags[i] & (uint)UnitFlags.Vehicle) == 0`, and line 391 gives a tank the braced accuracy for the same reason. Only the armour-piercing branch (entered at :354 for a vehicle shooter or a HuntsArmour man) left it out. The one unit this branch exists for is the Skimmer (UnitDefinitions.cs:69-77: HuntsArmour, speed 3.4 m/s, a gun whose only job is hunting light machines), so the hunter is at half odds the whole time it hunts, while the same gun at infantry a metre away is at full odds. decisions.md:322-324 records that the Skimmer never beat a Tusk in ten fights and :285 queues skimmer-14mm to re-measure; that measurement is taken through this halving. Same two lines: :366 rolls against raw `odds` with no `math.clamp(odds, 0.02f, 0.95f)`, which :418 and Wrecks:170 both apply -- today's tables stay under 0.95 (the AT rifle peaks at 0.6 x 1.3 = 0.78) so nothing is broken yet, but a 0.74 accuracy ever baked would make a hull hit certain, and there is no 0.02 floor at long range either. P1 for the exemption, P2 for the clamp.

tasks.title: Burning's highWater field is dead and its comment contradicts Hash
tasks.why: Burning.cs:67 declares `int highWater;` with the comment 'what the last Step saw, so Hash() knows how far AlightUntil is live', and Step writes it at :139. Nothing ever reads it: Hash at :305 folds the WHOLE array, `SimHash.Array(AlightUntil, AlightUntil.Length, h)`, on purpose ('every slot: a crewman spawned after this system's step still counts (critic r4)'). So the field is dead and its comment states the opposite of what the hash does. A hashed array's bound is exactly the kind of line a reader trusts without checking, and the next person to touch the hash here is told to clip it to highWater, which would undo critic r4 and move the tick hash. P3, cleanup, but on a seam surface.
